label: BLOCK 02
prompt:
DURATION: 15 SECONDS
FORMAT: HORIZONTAL 16:9

Create six distinct live-action cinematic shots:
L04: 00:00–00:02.
L05: 00:02–00:04.
L06: 00:04–00:06.5.
L07: 00:06.5–00:08.
L08: 00:08–00:11.
L09: 00:11–00:15.

Begin with both sisters already suspended 1.2 meters above
a smooth, continuous flat floor.

Zahhak already holds his staff raised.
Strong upward circulating air is already moving the women’s
hair and loose clothing.

Maintain this suspended state through the first five shots.
The women descend only in the final shot.


CHARACTER REFERENCES

Zahhak: {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}
Shahrnaz: {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz: {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}

Preserve exact identities, costumes, hairstyles, proportions
and sculptural masks.

Both sisters have real eyes visible through existing mask openings.
Their masks remain rigid and firmly attached to their heads.
The edges of the eye openings retain their exact shape.
Real eyes move independently behind the openings.

Preserve Arnavaz’s slightly lowered left shoulder
and existing stone dust on her left garment.

Zahhak’s shoulder serpents are living animals.
Their necks flex, heads adjust and elongated bodies slide
against his clothing.
Each serpent has one head and one continuous body.


ANIMAL REFERENCE

Shahrnaz’s cat: {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

The cat remains in Shahrnaz’s arms throughout.
Her left forearm supports its abdomen and hindquarters.
Her right hand supports its chest.
Its body stays close to her torso.


PROP REFERENCE

Serpent-headed staff: {{PROP_STAFF}}

The staff retains its exact referenced design.
Its carved head remains rigid and inanimate.
Zahhak holds it in his RIGHT hand throughout.


ENVIRONMENT AND LIGHTING

The chamber is concealed by solid blackness.

One fixed, hard, cold-neutral spotlight shines vertically down
over Zahhak and the suspended sisters.

It catches upper mask planes, hands, shoulders, the cat,
moving fabric and the staff.
Lower surfaces fall into deep shadow.

Its intensity, direction, color and exposure remain constant
across all six shots.

The floor is a smooth, matte charcoal architectural surface:
one perfectly level, continuous plane extending into darkness.

The small illuminated area beneath the women is merely light
falling across this flat floor.
Its edge has zero thickness and zero change in elevation.

The 1.2-meter gap between the women’s feet and the floor
contains visibly empty air.

Preserve black surroundings and clear air.
The supernatural force is expressed through bodily tension,
levitation and strong movement of hair and clothing.


FIXED SPATIAL ARRANGEMENT

Zahhak is SCREEN LEFT, facing SCREEN RIGHT.

Shahrnaz is nearer the camera at CENTER-RIGHT,
facing SCREEN LEFT toward Zahhak.

Arnavaz is 80 centimeters deeper and 45 centimeters farther
to SCREEN RIGHT, also facing SCREEN LEFT.

Both women remain vertically above their own starting footprints.

All camera positions stay on the same side of the action axis.
Close-ups preserve these orientations.

Strong upward circulating airflow continues around both women.
Their bodies stay in place while loose hair and garment panels
move forcefully around them.


SHOT L04 — THE EMPTY GAP
00:00–00:02

65mm low close-up of the sisters’ dangling feet and lower garments.
Camera approximately 35 centimeters above floor level,
looking slightly upward from the established side.

Shahrnaz’s feet occupy the nearer LEFT portion of this detail frame.
Arnavaz’s feet occupy the deeper RIGHT portion.

Include both pairs of feet and the flat illuminated floor
1.2 meters below them in the same composition.

Their toes point downward with small involuntary adjustments.
The space beneath them stays completely open.

Loose garment edges whip upward and sideways,
intermittently revealing ankles.

Use a tense handheld lateral adjustment of a few centimeters.
Keep the distance from feet to floor readable.

Cut on a garment panel snapping across the upper frame.


SHOT L05 — ARNAVAZ’S EYES
00:02–00:04

100mm extreme close-up of Arnavaz’s eyes through her mask.
Camera is at her elevated eye level,
on the front three-quarter side within the established camera
half-space.

Her mask points slightly toward SCREEN LEFT, toward Zahhak.

The camera holds its position relative to her head.
Her mask contours and eye-hole edges remain stable.

Her real eyes roll upward behind the openings.
A slight muscular tension appears in the exposed skin around them.

Loose strands of hair lash across the outer edge of the mask.
The hard overhead light catches its upper ridge and a tiny
reflection on the curved eye surfaces.

Keep focus on the real eyes and the nearest fixed mask edge.

Her interrupted breath is audible beneath the wind.


SHOT L06 — SHAHRNAZ PROTECTS THE CAT
00:04–00:06.5

50mm intimate close-up at Shahrnaz’s suspended chest height,
from the established side.

Shahrnaz faces SCREEN LEFT.
Frame her lower mask, shoulders, both supporting forearms
and the entire held cat.

The background is black.
Arnavaz and Zahhak remain outside this tight composition.

Shahrnaz’s upper body shudders once.
Her left forearm continues supporting the animal’s lower body.
Her right hand draws its chest closer against her own torso.

The cat presses its paws into her garment.
Its ears stay angled back.
Exposed fur ripples strongly in the airflow.

Loose hair and fabric stream past the protected animal.
Shahrnaz lowers her masked face slightly toward it.

Use intimate handheld movement with a small corrective reframe
following her shoulder tremor.
Maintain clear contact between hands, cat and torso.


SHOT L07 — ARNAVAZ’S EMPTY HAND
00:06.5–00:08

85mm detail of Arnavaz’s empty right hand beside her hip.

Her torso remains oriented toward SCREEN LEFT.
Her hand hangs below the edge of her sleeve.

The fingers contract sharply once.
A brief tremor runs through the wrist.
The fingers then loosen into a passive, slightly curved position.

A free garment panel pulls taut behind the hand
and flutters violently through the background.

Focus remains on the fingers.
The overhead light defines the knuckles against blackness.

Cut as the hand releases.


SHOT L08 — ZAHHAK HOLDS THEM
00:08–00:11

65mm low-angle medium close-up of Zahhak from the established side.

Zahhak occupies SCREEN LEFT and CENTER.
He faces SCREEN RIGHT, looking upward toward the suspended women.

His mask, right hand and carved staff head are all readable.
The sisters remain off-screen right.

The camera stays near his chest height and tilts slightly upward.
Use controlled handheld stillness.

His right hand holds the raised staff with almost effortless control.
His torso remains quiet and firmly grounded.

One living shoulder serpent slowly turns its head toward
the off-screen women.
Another visible section of serpent body flexes against his garment.

The carved serpent head of the staff remains completely rigid.

Wind-driven fabric sounds continue from off-screen right.

Zahhak’s calm gaze holds for the duration.
The staff remains raised through the cut.


SHOT L09 — RETURN TO THE FLOOR
00:11–00:15

Cut to a 35mm low three-quarter full-body composition
from the same side of the axis.

Zahhak stands SCREEN LEFT, facing right.
Shahrnaz hangs at CENTER-RIGHT, nearer the camera.
Arnavaz hangs deeper and farther RIGHT.
Both women face left toward Zahhak.

Include their entire bodies, suspended feet,
and the continuous smooth floor beneath them.

00:11–00:13.5:
Zahhak lowers the staff in one deliberate movement.

Both women descend simultaneously from their 1.2-meter height,
directly toward their original footprints.

The handheld camera tilts downward with them.
Maintain the descent in one uninterrupted shot.

Airflow weakens as they approach the floor.
Their toes touch first, followed by their soles.
Their knees soften as their weight returns.

Shahrnaz keeps the cat supported throughout the landing.

00:13.5–00:14.3:
The airflow stops completely.
Hair and loose clothing fall under their own weight.
The final moving folds settle against their bodies.

Their bodily tremors cease.
Both release a quiet breath.

00:14.3–00:15:
Both women stand unnervingly still.
Their natural eyes settle toward Zahhak.
Their posture has lost its earlier resistance.

Zahhak remains grounded on the left with the staff lowered.
His living serpents continue small independent movements.

Hold the final arrangement until exactly 15 seconds.
Cut directly to black.


EDITING AND SOUND

Use five hard cuts between the six shots.
The continuous wind and fabric sounds connect the inserts
into one ongoing supernatural event.

L04:
Forceful garment flutter and rushing air.

L05:
Arnavaz’s caught breath beneath the same airflow.

L06:
Fabric straining, fur moving and Shahrnaz’s uneven breathing.

L07:
A brief sharp cloth movement as the fingers contract.

L08:
The sisters’ wind and clothing remain audible off-screen;
a faint staff-grip creak sounds close to the camera.

L09:
Wind diminishes, feet contact the flat floor,
cloth settles and both women exhale.

Cut sound to absolute silence with the final black frame.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
